title: SchcError::FragmentError variant loses fragment-specific error details
description:
## Location
- /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/error.rs lines 54-55

## Problem
```rust
pub enum SchcError {
    // ...
    FragmentError,
}
```

The `FragmentError` variant is a unit variant with no payload. Meanwhile, `fragment::wire::FragmentError` has 13 specific variants (InvalidRule, InvalidWindow, InvalidFcn, InvalidDtag, etc.).

There is no `From<FragmentError>` impl to convert the detailed error to `SchcError`, and if there were, the details would be lost.

## API Risk
Callers using the top-level `SchcError` type cannot distinguish between different fragment failure modes. They only see "fragmentation error" without knowing if it was an invalid rule, invalid window, malformed ACK, etc.

## Suggested Fix
Either:
1. Add `SchcError::Fragment(FragmentError)` variant (breaking change)
2. Keep them separate - document that fragmentation uses its own error type
3. Add error code field to the unit variant: `FragmentError(u8)` with documented codes

Option 2 is already the current approach if callers use `fragment::FragmentError` directly. Document this pattern.
